property_summary: For any address newOwner and any EOA caller who is the current owner (msg.sender == owner), after calling transferOwnership(newOwner) the contract's owner() equals the provided newOwner; the mutant that assigns owner = tx.origin can violate this when tx.origin != newOwner.
change_summary: Assign owner to tx.origin instead of newOwner so owner becomes the original transaction sender rather than the provided address.
